title: Collection recipe registry
description: Maps each canonical Check ID to HOW it is collected (adapter + params). Applicability (what is allowed) lives in checklist.v1.json; this file only describes collection. Selection-driven: the collector runs a recipe only for check_ids the registry selected as runnable, so prohibited (X) checks are never collected.

recipes.description: Keyed by canonical Check ID (e.g. SQL-01). Every key must exist in checklist.v1.json; cross-validated at load time.

adapter.description: Name of a registered adapter in scripts/collection_adapters.py. Generic adapters are config-driven; named adapters carry real logic.

params.description: Adapter-specific parameters. Each adapter validates its own params; shapes below are advisory.

kind.description: range -> distribution; instant -> scalar. Default range.

unit.description: Base unit of the raw value, recorded in evidence.

scale.description: Multiply the raw value by this before applying the rule and before display (e.g. 1000 for seconds -> ms, 100 for a ratio -> percent). Default 1.

rule_statistic.description: Which distribution statistic feeds the threshold rule (promql_distribution). Default max.

rule.description: Rule name resolved against config/rules.v1.json (Phase 5). Use "none" for observation-only checks (HEALTHY when evidence exists, N/A when empty).
